Resolves #21222

`Neo.board.CardEditor` builds its form from the model it edits. A standard field (title, description, status, lane, assignees, tags, progress, color, due date) is built when the board's model declares it; the title and status are always built. The model's other fields follow under labels read from their names, a `Boolean` field as a check box, and calculated fields stay out. A new `fields` config, passed through the board's `cardEditorConfig`, names the form instead: a name picks a standard or model field, an object is a field config of its own. Building it turned up a second defect: a `Date` field the user left alone wrote its day back as a string on every save. Every Date field now converts its value the way `dueDate` already did.

Evidence: L3 (unit specs on the editor, and the board example's e2e in local headless Chromium) → L3 required (AC-5 runs the board example in a browser; the other ACs are form contents and save payloads).

## AC Evidence

| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| AC-1 a model without `assignees`, `tags`, `color` or `dueDate` gets none of them | `CardEditor.spec.mjs` "a model of its own gets the standard fields it declares": the form is exactly title, description, status, progress, start date, all day and resource id. |
| AC-2 readable labels, and a `Boolean` field as a check box whose save writes a Boolean | Same spec: labels "Start date", "All day", "Resource id", and `allDay` is a `CheckBox`. "a Boolean field is a check box": checking it as a click does is one record change, `allDay: true`. |
| AC-3 an untouched `Date` field writes nothing | "a date the user leaves alone writes nothing": a save after a progress edit returns `{progress: 60}`, and the start date keeps its instant. |
| AC-4 `fields` sets the form and its order; a save writes the changed ones | "`fields` names the form in order": the form is exactly the five listed fields, in order, with the object entry's own label. A save returns exactly the two edited fields, in one record change that the calculated field follows. |
| AC-5 the board example's form is unchanged; `BasicNL` stays green | "a CardModel store keeps every standard field, in the order it always had", plus the existing editor arms. `board/BasicNL`: 9 passed locally. |
| AC-6 unit specs cover AC-1 to AC-4 | The eight new arms in `test/playwright/unit/board/CardEditor.spec.mjs`: the five above, plus three from the review. A calculated standard field is not offered; a `fields` config named lane stays an ordinary field; a reused editor rebuilds its derived form for a new store's model. |

## Deltas from ticket

- **The untouched-date defect** was found while building the fix and is now AC-3 of the ticket.
- **Calculated fields stay out of the derived form**, since an edit to one would be dropped.

## Test Evidence

- **Red first, on `dev` at `825047c9ea`:** with the first spec, 4 of the 5 new arms fail (AC-1, AC-2, AC-3, AC-4). The CardModel arm passes, as the guard it is. The Boolean arm toggles `checked` the way a click does; set through `setFieldValue`, a text field also passed it on `dev`.
- **Red first, on the reviewed head `043788f52c`:** the three review arms fail there and pass at `4e3fae3dce`.

## Post-Merge Validation

None owed. #20884 (PR #21223) names the Workstation's work-item fields through `fields` once this lands.

- `043788f52c`: the unit witnesses
- `4e3fae3dce`: Euclid's three review actions: calculated standard fields left out, a lane config kept ordinary, the derived form rebuilt for a new store's model

With calculated progress = units × 2, the derived editor offers Progress at 50; entering 70 makes Save return {progress:70}, but the Record remains 50. Rebuild or reconcile the derived field set at this supported Store/model boundary, retiring obsolete controls and preserving explicit fields, child ownership and the existing stale-Record save guard. This is ordinary Store replacement, not live mutation of a Model's schema.
